caveats: Pool counters count physical RPC input slots/attempts; NTRN logical children and canonical transfers are different units.
Refresh successes require a completed batch with at least one accepted unique native input; successes, exhaustion and deadlines overlap.
Accepted refresh inputs are deduplicated within one batch only and include repeated exact-hash idempotent RPC retries, not necessarily new insertions.
Attempts, accepted inputs and signature reuses update before batch completion; interior boundaries can contain carry-in/out and abandoned partial work.
Signature reuses count avoided dispatches even when later rejected. Verification timing samples are per pass, including reused-signature prechecks.
Stage times are overlapping wall residence and preemption/waiting, not exclusive CPU. The block signature executor does not count pool verifier dispatches.
Per-canonical-transfer stage values are rate-normalized estimates: interior stage wall/s divided by full-window proof-checked canonical TPS, not an exact matched cohort.
One pair does not establish repeatability or peak capacity. Offered load must independently exceed canonical throughput by five percent for capacity eligibility.
CPU equivalents are arithmetic means of interior Docker CPU percentage samples divided by 100, not integrated CPU seconds or exclusive function CPU.
Docker CPU sampling follows getstats. Only records at least 25 seconds before measurement end are used, matching the capture command timeout; exact CPU averaging windows were not saved.
CPU per canonical transfer is a rate-normalized estimate using full-window proof-checked TPS and interior sampled CPU equivalents.
Overlay before/after captures include readiness, warmup and drain; their matched counter increases are incomplete observable lower bounds, never TPS-window totals.
Changing one named flag isolates configuration, not all time-dependent conditions; one sequential pair does not establish repeatability or maximum capacity.

The historical wrapper omitted TON_KEYRING_PREPARED_SIGNING and TON_OVERLAY_LOCAL_SIGNATURE_REUSE from its environment whitelist. Only these missing fields may be recovered from the saved Docker controller identity, with successful unchanged-container, strict before/after identity and immutable image linkage. Field provenance is explicit; conflicting or absent evidence fails validation.

Two legacy arms lacking comparison-environment.json may be compared with unverified VM resource equality. New arms require matching recorded Docker VM memory/CPU and physical host memory; missing evidence on only one side or malformed evidence fails comparison.

An explicit duration reassessment may resolve only a reproduced sole floating-point duration rejection after a successful wrapper. Original controller exit remains recorded, and only the certificate-proven postprocessing source revision change may differ across arms.

caveats: These captures bracket client startup through full cleanup, not the 600-second measurement cohort. No TPS or per-second rate is inferred.
Only matching (overlay_id, adnl_id) sections with stable mode/metadata and nondecreasing valid counters contribute net deltas.
New, removed, reset, mode-changed, missing or invalid sections are excluded rather than filled with zero. Their endpoint lifetime counters remain visible for diagnosis.
A session can be created and retired entirely between endpoints; even identical endpoint sets and monotonic counters cannot prove complete coverage or uninterrupted actor identity.
Net increases are observable lower bounds between each section's corresponding observations. Reset-and-regrow within a matched section can conceal additional work.
After-endpoint lifetime counters are not interval deltas and may include work before the run. They are never added to the interval lower bound.
The reuse fraction describes matched net counts only; it is not a lower bound on the global reuse fraction or a CPU saving.
crypto_checks counts entry into the original signature-check path (including certificate/type/factory failures), not exclusively completed Ed25519 operations.
